_note: v1 entries compiled 2026-10-11, v2 entries (12 new species) added the same day. The sandbox could not open wikimedia.org (WebFetch DNS failure, curl proxy 403), so every entry was confirmed only through web-search renderings of the Commons file pages: file exists, author, licence, place/date and species named in the description. Nobody has looked at the pixels yet, hence verified=false everywhere. fetch_photos.py (CI) re-reads the licence from Commons extmetadata and flags any mismatch. Author names are the photographers' own Commons credits, kept because CC BY / CC BY-SA require attribution.
